product_defect.title: A permitted move to an empty unsuppressed region center is edited as a central POI and can create duplicate physical POIs
product_defect.requirement: E8 M01 explicitly permits a region center without a real central object; AC01/06/09/11 require a usable ordinary moved POI and consistent subsequent editing.

locations.note: Target accepts center with no actual central object, as specified.
Metadata marks center without requiring centralPoiKind; ordinary type edit is blocked and central editor is rendered.

supported_input.description: Structurally valid accepted legacy/import state. No existing central POI before move; this is explicitly a permitted destination, not an unsupported overlapping-input map.

steps: Select2,0, enter Edit, click Location, set q=3 r=0, click Done.
Move succeeds: region2.pointsOfInterest=[{q:3,r:0}], pointOfInterestKinds[3,0]=village, centralPoiKind absent, selectedHex3,0.
Enter Edit and click Edit point. Control offers central choices including capital and lacks No point.
Choose ruins. Export shows centralPoiKind=ruins while ordinary pointOfInterestKinds[3,0] remains village; the ordinary move control disappears.
Undo restores the moved map exactly; Redo restores the duplicate-object map exactly.
product_defect.expected: The moved ordinary POI remains the selected/editable ordinary POI at an otherwise empty center. Type/removal/move/name operations preserve one physical identity; center/anchor remain protected for E7 geometry.
product_defect.impact: Ordinary type editing silently creates another object rather than changing the moved POI; the resulting central+ordinary collision cannot be moved or named unambiguously. Ordinary editor controls are hidden even immediately after the allowed move.
product_defect.bounded_fix: Unify actual-central-object detection for the permitted empty-center destination across selection/type/name/position paths. Preserve unconditional E7 center/anchor protection. Reuse existing regionEditing and POI browser lifecycles for center-without-central-object relocation, ordinary type edit/delete/move and exact Undo/Redo/reload regression.
